home.welcome: Welcome to the Social Impact Art Gallery
home.hero_title: Art to contemplate. Impact to build.
home.about_title: Social Impact Art Gallery — Hawk Stars NGO
home.about_1: The Social Impact Art Gallery is an artistic and theoretical project run by Hawk Stars NGO - Association for Education, Innovation and Social Development, curated by visual artist and researcher Romy Castro and architect and visual artist Sofia F. Augusto.
home.about_2: It aims to help fund the many social projects promoted by Hawk Stars to develop Portugal's interior. The first goal of the Social Impact Art Gallery is to promote the Arts and Artists.
home.about_3: While promoting artists, it also contributes financially, through the sale of artworks, to rebuilding the building that will house the International Training Centre, part of Hawk Stars NGO's Global Village Project in the city of Pinhel, in the district of Guarda, Portugal.
home.about_quote: Once this goal is achieved, the Art Gallery will continue as a crowdfunding platform to fund other social impact projects.

subtitle: The Social Impact Art Gallery is an artistic and theoretical project run by Hawk Stars NGO for Education, Innovation and Social Development, with professional curators Romy Castro, Plastic/Visual Artist and Researcher, and Sofia F. Augusto, Architect and Visual Artist. Its aim is to contribute to the funding of various social projects promoted by Hawk Stars, in order to socially develop the interior of the country.
description_1: The Social Impact Art Gallery's primary aim is to promote the arts and artists. At the same time as promoting artists, it also aims to make a financial contribution, through the sale of works of art, to the reconstruction of the building that will house the International Training Center as part of the Global Village Project of the NGO Hawk Stars, which will take place in the city of Pinhel, in the district of Guarda, Portugal.
description_2: Once this goal has been achieved, the Art Gallery will continue to exist as a Crowdfunding platform to finance other possible social impact projects.
